title: CUE：校准用户嵌入实现多轮交互基准测试
summary: 提出CUE框架，通过编码真实用户会话并采样连续表示，解码为角色指令来引导LLM模拟用户，无需训练。在τ²-Bench上，CUEd模拟器减少模拟器归因错误，更忠实复现真实用户的智能体失败模式与成功率，且可跨任务和不同LLM泛化。
summary_en: Introduces Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE), a framework that encodes observed sessions and samples continuous representations, then decodes them into persona commands to steer LLMs as user simulators without training. On τ²-Bench, CUEd simulators commit fewer simulator-attributed errors and more faithfully reproduce real-user agent failure modes, success rates, and outcomes, generalizing across tasks and simulator LLMs.
